description: This file contains the definition of the BaseRule class, a utility base class for handling metadata rules and field parsing in the SuiteCRM framework. It provides methods for parsing panels, identifying custom fields, matching patterns, and extracting match groups.

classes.name: BaseRule
classes.description: A utility base class for refining metadata rule processing, including parsing panels, detecting custom fields, pattern matching, and capturing regex groups.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for the BaseRule class.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Returns the panels as-is before any processing.

methods.name: postParse
methods.description: Processes panels after initial parsing; by default, calls parsePanels.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to be overridden; currently returns panels unchanged.

methods.name: isCustomField
methods.description: Determines if a field is a custom field based on naming convention '_c' at the end.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a field's name matches a given regular expression.

methods.name: getMatch
methods.description: Extracts matched groups from a field's name based on a regular expression.
